settings.homeTitle: Stop doing by hand what a computer can do *on its own*.
settings.homeIntro: I build automations that cut down and simplify any kind of computer work: reports, Excel sheets, documents, copy and paste, data scattered across emails and folders. You bring me the problem, I solve it. And the hours you now lose on repetitive tasks go back to your real work. Talking about it costs nothing and commits you to nothing.

Python, Excel, SQL and artificial intelligence

settings.aboutTitle: Hi, I'm Daniele. I teach computers to *work for you*.
settings.aboutIntro: I build automations and custom software with Python, Excel, SQL and artificial intelligence. My obsession is simple: if a computer task repeats itself, sooner or later I automate it. Write to me whenever you like: the first contact is free and with no obligation.
settings.about:
It all started with a question I keep asking myself: why do something by hand, every day, that a computer could do on its own in a few seconds?

So I started building. Today I develop software with the help of artificial intelligence, which I use every day as a working tool: it lets me design, write and refine programs quickly, without giving up attention to detail.

On this site you'll find some of the projects I've built: apps for learning programming and English, tools that gather data and news from financial markets around the world and turn them into information you can read at a glance, and a few classic games. They are concrete proof of what I can do.

For businesses and professionals I create tailor-made solutions: automations, Excel sheets that update themselves, databases, programs that eliminate repetitive work. The goal is always the same: reliable tools that are simple to use and genuinely useful.

mun8vbdr71vb7.tagline: See what is happening on markets around the world right now!
mun8vbdr71vb7.description: This app collects the finance articles published by all the major financial websites over the last week. muokmzza3pjsy.tagline: Spot at a glance which selected S&P 500 stocks are worth buying!
muokmzza3pjsy.description: This app is for anyone looking for entry opportunities in the financial markets without spending hours on research and analysis. Showing where the price stands on a scale that looks like a thermometer lets you recognise favourable opportunities at a glance! Combining simplicity and effectiveness, it shows some of the most important analysis parameters: the moving average and the POC (Point of Control, the typical price), both over 200 periods (the last 200 days), the low and the high and where the price stands relative to them, and finally a number in the top-right corner of each card that, once enabled, gives a score from 1 to 10 measuring the quality of the fundamental data (balance sheet, earnings, P/E, debt, etc.). A default filter initially shows only the companies whose price is at least 10% below both the POC and the SMA, but you can also filter the thermometers in many other ways: price range, fundamental scores and percentage distances. Finally, in the top-right corner of each thermometer there is a small question mark: click it and Gemini gives you a simple, clear overview of that company's current situation, based exclusively on data from SEC EDGAR (one of the most authoritative sources of financial data). Here too you need a Gemini API key, which you can create for free at: https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
muokmzza3pjsy.trialInfo: Don't forget to get your free API key first, so you can use the app with all its features! Here is the link: https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
muokmzza3pjsy.requirements: Runs directly from the site, in the browser: no download or installation, on a phone too. An internet connection is required. For the AI-written explanations (the question mark on each thermometer) and for better searches you need a free Gemini API key: https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
muokmzza3pjsy.name: SP500 VERTICAL THERMOMETERS

muontpfbbtfq3.tagline: Boost your English vocabulary with WordQuest!
muontpfbbtfq3.description: WordQuest turns studying English into a game that's hard to put down. Each question shows you a word and four answers: pick the right one, earn experience points, level up and unlock trophies. Behind the fun there is a serious method. The words you get wrong come back more often until you have really learned them (smart repetition), while the ones you already know make room for new ones. The vocabulary has 3,000 words and expressions: verbs, nouns, adjectives, phrasal verbs and idioms from everyday life and work. It covers all European levels, from beginner A1 to advanced C2, in both directions, from English to Italian and vice versa. As you play, WordQuest estimates your English level in real time, so you can watch your progress day by day. Ten minutes a day is all it takes!
muontpfbbtfq3.features:
3,000 words and expressions across the 6 European levels (A1–C2)
5 game modes: Mixed, English → Italian, Italian → English, Lightning Mode (60 seconds, double points) and Hard Words Only
Smart repetition: words you get wrong come back until you master them
English level calculated in real time
Experience points, levels, combos up to x3 and daily streaks
24 trophies to unlock
Daily goal of your choice: relaxed, normal, motivated or intense
Rare words as collectible cards: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary
Hint: removes one wrong answer when you're stuck
Confetti, sounds and effects that reward every step forward
Can be played with the keyboard alone (keys 1–4)
Level filter: practise only the words that suit you
Your progress stays saved in your browser, even after closing the site
muontpfbbtfq3.requirements: Runs directly from the site, in the browser: no download or installation, on a phone too. No API key needed. Your progress stays saved in the browser of the device you use.
muontpfbbtfq3.name: WORDQUEST

sqlquest01.tagline: Learn SQL by doing: a simulator with a real database, exercises and solutions!
sqlquest01.description: SQLQuest is an SQL simulator that runs directly in the browser, with a real database (an online shop: customers, products, orders and employees). Each lesson explains a concept with an example to run, then gives you an exercise: write the query, press Check and the app compares your result with the correct one, explaining in Italian what's wrong. You start from your first SELECT and work up to JOINs, subqueries, window functions and data modification.
sqlquest01.features:
55 exercises in 9 modules, from the basics to advanced level
Automatic checking with explanations of the errors (in Italian)
Hints, expected result and solution for every exercise
Free lab to experiment with any command
Progress, stars and experience points saved in the browser
sqlquest01.trialInfo: Free and with no sign-up: use it directly in the browser, on a phone too.
sqlquest01.requirements: An up-to-date browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari).
sqlquest01.name: SQLQUEST

convertitore01.tagline: Upload a file and pick the format: images, PDFs, documents, Excel and audio, without uploading anything to the internet!
convertitore01.description: The simplest converter there is: drop in your file, the app recognises its type by itself and shows you every format it can be turned into. Choose the one you need and download the result. It works with images (including iPhone HEIC photos), PDFs, Word documents, Excel sheets, audio and video. Everything happens on your device: your files are never uploaded to a server, so you can use it with confidential documents too.
convertitore01.features:
Images → JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF, SVG or PDF
PDF → images (JPG, PNG, WebP, TIFF) or editable documents (DOCX, ODT, RTF, TXT, HTML, Markdown)
DOCX, ODT, RTF, HTML, Markdown and TXT documents → DOCX, ODT, RTF, PDF, HTML, Markdown or TXT
XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, JSON and other spreadsheets → XLSX, XLS, XLSB, ODS, CSV, TSV, JSON, XML, HTML, SQL or Markdown
Audio and video → MP3, WAV or AIFF
Recognises the file type by itself and suggests only compatible formats
Several files at once, with "Convert all" and a single ZIP download
Respects the European decimal comma and codes with leading zeros
Private: your files never leave your device
Available in 6 languages
convertitore01.trialInfo: Free, with no sign-up and no limits: use it directly in the browser, on a phone too.
convertitore01.requirements: An up-to-date browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari). With very large files, your device's power matters.
convertitore01.name: FILE CONVERTER

qrcode01.tagline: Create QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, business cards and WhatsApp, with your colours and your logo!
qrcode01.description: Create a QR code in seconds to print on flyers, business cards, menus, shop windows or labels. Choose what happens when someone scans it: open your website, join your Wi-Fi without typing the password, save your contact to their address book, email you, call you, or send you an SMS or a WhatsApp message. Customise colours and dot shape, add your logo in the centre and download it as PNG, SVG or PDF. The code is static: it works forever, with no subscriptions and no expiry date.
qrcode01.features:
8 content types: link, text, Wi-Fi, contact (vCard), email, phone, SMS and WhatsApp
Instant preview as you type
Colours of your choice, transparent background and three dot shapes: square, rounded or round
Logo in the centre, with maximum error correction to stay readable
Download as PNG (up to 4096 pixels), vector SVG for print and PDF
Warning if the chosen colours make the code hard to read
Static codes: they work forever, with no subscriptions and no expiry
Private: the data you enter never leaves your device
Available in 6 languages
qrcode01.trialInfo: Free and with no sign-up: use it directly in the browser, on a phone too.
qrcode01.requirements: An up-to-date browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari).
qrcode01.name: QR CODE GENERATOR
